findings_qualitative.value: The MP Mus warm and cool disks are predominantly amorphous silicates, with large grains in the warm disk, small pyroxene in the cool disk, and crystalline silicates indicating grain processing

evidence.quote: The results indicate that both disks are predominantly composed of amorphous minerals

findings_qualitative.value: The EaRTH model implies a small inner cavity (0.08 au) and a gap from ~0.1 to ~0.85 au that ALMA and SPHERE could not resolve

evidence.quote: it is possible that there is a small inner cavity in the disk of MP Mus that these images could not show

claims.hypothesis: Empirical mid-IR mineralogy can be used as input to MCFOST to fit the SED with both mineralogical and structural parameters
claims.experiment: TZTD fit of Spitzer IRS spectrum, then MCFOST temperature-structure fit and SED fine-tuning
claims.result: TZTD reduced chi-squared 2.63; EaRTH reduced chi-squared 10.81
claims.finding: The hybrid model gives a robust IR fit, though the TZTD fit alone is better

evidence.quote: MCFOST produces a robust fit in the infrared regime

claims.hypothesis: What dust composition do the warm and cool zones of the MP Mus disk have
claims.experiment: TZTD fit with the new opacity set
claims.result: Warm: large amorphous olivine 56.1 and pyroxene 34.8 percent; cool: small amorphous pyroxene 76.1 and large crystalline forsterite 15.8 percent
claims.finding: Both disks are mostly amorphous with grain growth in warm and cool regions and significant crystalline silicate

evidence.quote: The results indicate that both disks are predominantly composed of amorphous minerals

claims.hypothesis: The Spitzer-constrained model implies a small inner cavity and gap not excluded by ALMA/SPHERE
claims.experiment: Compared EaRTH inner radius and temperature structure with ALMA and SPHERE resolution limits
claims.result: Inner radius 0.08 au, gap ~0.1 to ~0.85 au, below the ALMA ~1 au resolution
claims.finding: A small inner cavity is possible but not detected by current images

evidence.quote: it is possible that there is a small inner cavity in the disk of MP Mus that these images could not show

claims.hypothesis: The MCFOST model reproduces the ALMA 1.3 mm continuum image
claims.experiment: Rendered 1.3 mm image convolved with the ALMA beam and compared radial profiles
claims.result: Good match within 0.6 arcsec, NRMSE 1.02 and 1.90 mJy/beam, but model flux falls off faster than observed
claims.finding: Model fits the inner image but is limited by simplified surface density assumptions

evidence.quote: the flux radially decreases much more slowly in the ALMA image than the EaRTH Disk-simulated image

claims.hypothesis: The SPHERE ring near 80 au is due to a small-grain ring or to shadowing
claims.experiment: Two amended MCFOST models compared with the SPHERE H-band radial profile
claims.result: Both give NRMSE 0.99; ring model gives a closer-looking image and better mid-IR SED
claims.finding: Models are degenerate, but the ring model is qualitatively closer

evidence.quote: This is indicative of the inherent degeneracy in the parameters that must be considered when generating representative models of a disk

why_this_data.value: MP Mus has high-quality infrared spectral and radio interferometric data and is a nearby disk

evidence.quote: We develop and test this model by fitting high-quality infrared spectral and radio interferometric data available

why_this_method.value: Fit temperature structure first because it is much faster than fitting SEDs and ties MCFOST to the empirical fit

evidence.quote: because this method is significantly faster, allowing many iterations to tune parameters

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Tested shadowing of intermediate disk regions as alternative to a small-grain ring for the SPHERE ring; ring model preferred qualitatively

evidence.quote: we hence tested a model to simulate this shadowing, this time without a small grain ring

limitations_admitted.value: No Bayesian error analysis because of computational cost

evidence.quote: we were not able to perform a Bayesian analysis to extract robust estimates of the errors on our parameter determination

limitations_admitted.value: Degeneracies between model dust components, especially cool amorphous silicates

evidence.quote: We note that degeneracies may be present between model dust components

limitations_admitted.value: Simplified assumptions limit fit to the ALMA image

evidence.quote: This is a limitation caused by some of the simplified assumptions of the EaRTH Disk Model

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA is only a secondary constraint; mass and outer radius were adopted from Ribas et al. 2023 rather than fitted
Reduced chi-squared of 10.81 is large and uncertainties come from a Delta chi-squared approach, not posterior sampling
The paper gives two different ALMA resolutions (69x50 mas beam vs 0.01 arcsec)
Fitted vs adopted parameters, and the large uncertainty on inner radius (0.08 +/- 0.25 au), weaken the cavity claim
